_doc: KNICKGASM lifecycle product-type facts. Single source of truth for the lifecycle calendar + mailer builder (api/_shared/lifecycle-*.js) and Social Media OS (api/_shared/social-core.js). SOURCE: the live knickgasm.com catalog fetched 2026-08-03 (436 active products, built into data/catalog/products_{us,uk,global}.json by scripts/build-catalog.js; USD @ INR 87.5 and GBP @ INR 110 fixed-rate conversions from INR list prices). Every count, product, handle, price and image below is copied from that catalog (GBP figures from products_uk.json, USD from products_us.json) - nothing here may be claimed unless it exists there. 'catalog_types' is the real product-type taxonomy; 'types' keeps the legacy consumer keys shape-compatible (see _key_note). Committed on purpose (data/catalog/ is gitignored build output; this is hand-curated).
_key_note: The type keys 'tb', 'coffee' and 'supplements' are LEGACY IDENTIFIERS consumed by api/_shared/lifecycle-*.js, social-core.js and lifecycle-cohorts.js. They are kept verbatim so those consumers keep working. Read them as: tb = the core custom-sneaker range, coffee = the coffee-ART collection (hand-painted coffee motifs on sneakers, not a drink), supplements = the accessories lane (laces, lace tags, care).

catalog_types._doc: Real product-type groups derived from the 'type' field of the live knickgasm.com catalog fetched 2026-08-03. count = active products in that group (sums to 436); price ranges are min-max across the group (USD from products_us.json, GBP from products_uk.json).

af1.label: Nike Air Force 1 Customs
af1.description: The flagship: hand-painted one-of-one Nike Air Force 1 customs, roughly 80% of the catalog. Themes counted from live product names: anime (59 - Naruto, One Piece, Dragon Ball), football clubs (32 - Manchester United, Real Madrid and more), cars and F1 (32 - GTR R34, Porsche, Ferrari, BMW), gaming and superheroes (16 - Spiderman, Captain America), pets (7 - customisable Doggo editions), bling/crystal (5), wedding customs (customisable with the outfit), plus celebrity editions (CR7, Messi, Taylor Swift, Travis Scott, Ranbir Kapoor).
af1.lifecycle_use: Default hero for nearly every campaign: story-led intros, theme-of-the-week rotations (anime drop, matchday, race-week), gifting pushes (pet and wedding customs), win-backs citing live compare-at prices.

court_vision.label: Nike Court Vision Customs
court_vision.description: Hand-painted Nike Court Vision customs - the accessible entry silhouette, priced below AF1.
court_vision.lifecycle_use: First-purchase and price-sensitive plays: entry-point offers for non-buyers, 'your first custom' onboarding sends.

converse.label: Converse Customs
converse.description: Hand-painted Converse customs - the lowest-priced sneaker canvas in the catalog.
converse.lifecycle_use: Entry-point and student/gift angles; canvas-art storytelling for discovery cohorts.

adidas_sambas.label: Adidas Sambas & Stan Smith Customs
adidas_sambas.description: Adidas Sambas and Stan Smith customs including F1 driver editions (Lewis Hamilton, Lando Norris), Messi, Ferrari, Doggo and Indian Cricket customs.
adidas_sambas.lifecycle_use: Trend-led sends (terrace style), F1 race-weekend and cricket-season moments.

air_jordan.label: Nike Air Jordan 1 Low Customs
air_jordan.description: Hand-painted Air Jordan 1 Low customs - anime (One Piece, Bleach, Luffy x Zoro), Captain America, golf and coffee-art themes. The premium sneaker tier.
air_jordan.lifecycle_use: Premium and VIP cohort heroes; upgrade path for repeat AF1 buyers.

other_nike.label: Other Nike Customs (Air Max, Dunks, AF1 Mids, Ebernon)
other_nike.description: Single-piece Nike customs outside the core lines: Nebula x Air Max, Nike Dunk Low Indigo Haze x Taylor Swift, AF1 Mids x Lionel Messi, Nike Ebernon x Cartoon.
other_nike.lifecycle_use: Scarcity-true one-of-one features and collector spotlights - each of these is a single live listing.

other_customs.label: Other Brand Customs (ARKS, Comet, Asics, Philipp Plein)
other_customs.description: Customs on Indian sneaker labels ARKS and Comet (Spiderman, Ranbir Kapoor, Tale of Two Cities editions), an Asics Stree 2 theme, and the top-of-catalog Philipp Plein Chunky Godzilla Color Wave custom.
other_customs.lifecycle_use: India-pride storytelling (homegrown silhouettes) and the Philipp Plein piece as the ultra-premium halo product.

denim_jackets.label: Denim Jackets
denim_jackets.description: Hand-painted artist-tribute denim jackets: Juice WRLD, Pop Smoke, Travis Scott. Single price point across all three.
denim_jackets.lifecycle_use: Cross-sell to sneaker buyers (complete-the-fit) and music-culture moments.

laces_accessories.label: Laces & Accessories
laces_accessories.description: Chunky rope laces (two colorways) and custom lace tags - the lowest-priced items in the catalog.
laces_accessories.lifecycle_use: Add-on and basket-builder plays, post-purchase 'style your pair' follow-ups, low-risk first conversion for non-buyers.

care_kits.label: Sneaker Care Kits
care_kits.description: Ultimate Sneaker Care Kit (handle sneaker-care-kit) - cleaning and protection for hand-painted customs. Live compare-at on store: £13.63, was £27.26.
care_kits.lifecycle_use: Post-purchase care education, replenishment reminders, attach-to-every-order cross-sell.

tb.label: Custom Sneakers
tb.notes: ONE-TIME purchase only - every pair is a one-of-one, made to order, so never use subscription or refill language for this lane. Full list (436 SKUs) lives in the store CSV export / data-catalog pipeline (products_export_uk.csv -> data/catalog/products_uk.json); the heroes below are the verified subset for lifecycle sends. Compare-at (was) prices are live store values - citing them is honest, not an invented discount. Every pair is hand-painted on a 100% original base sneaker, finished water and scratch resistant, and made to order in 10 to 15 days.

coffee.label: coffee-ART Collection
coffee.notes: The coffee-ART collection is a PAINT THEME, not a drink: coffee-dip washes, latte-swirl and cartoon-coffee motifs hand-painted onto original Nike Air Force 1, Court Vision and Air Jordan 1 Low bases. Sold as one-of-one pairs, one-time purchase only - KNICKGASM runs no subscription of any kind, so never write subscribe / refill / auto-ship copy for this lane. The two entries under 'packs' are the price ladder by base sneaker model, not multi-unit bundles.
coffee.collection_slug_note: Fallback destination if the product handle 404s.

packs.label: Court Vision base
packs._field_note: LEGACY KEYS. 'one_time_gbp' and 'subscription_gbp' both carry the single live store price for Coffee (Rope Laces) x Nike Court Vision, handle nike-court-vision-x-coffee-with-chunky-rope-laces-1 (compare-at £104.00). There is no subscription price because there is no subscription; the duplicate key is kept only so existing consumers keep reading a valid number.

packs.label: Air Jordan 1 Low base
packs.b2g1_framing: Same hand-painted coffee artwork, stepped up a base model: Court Vision £89.09, Air Force 1 £108.27, Air Jordan 1 Low £141.91. State the ladder, never invent a bundle or a discount code.
packs._field_note: LEGACY KEYS. Both price fields carry the single live store price for Nike Air Jordan 1 Lows x Coffee, handle nike-air-jordan-1-lows-x-coffee-dip-rope-laces (compare-at £190.26).

gifts: Hand-painted by India's best sneaker artists
Made to order in 10 to 15 days
coffee.gifts_note: LEGACY KEY. This is NOT a free-gift list - it is what every coffee-ART order includes as standard. KNICKGASM gives no free gifts with orders; do not write gift-with-purchase copy from this field.
coffee.sub_gift_hook: There is no subscription and no gift-value claim. The honest hook is the craft: an original AF1, Court Vision or Jordan 1 Low, hand-painted with coffee-dip artwork, one pair only, finished water and scratch resistant.

supplements.label: Accessories
supplements.notes: LEGACY KEY 'supplements' = the accessories lane: chunky rope laces and custom lace tags that finish a pair. One-time purchase only. These are low-ticket add-ons, so the lifecycle role is attachment and reorder rather than headline revenue - the CTA goes to the product page and never to a subscription. Prices are live store values but this lane is deliberately routed price-free in social copy; cite the PDP instead.
